description: Three days, one island. Here’s how to get here. The field notes below cover what to do once you land.

steps.title: Fly to Caticlan
steps.body: Caticlan (MPH) is the closest airport, about 1 hr from Manila or Cebu. Kalibo (KLO) has more flights but adds ~2 hrs by van to the jetty port.

steps.title: Cross by boat
steps.body: From Caticlan Jetty Port, take the 15-min boat to Cagban Port. Pay the terminal and environmental fees at the counter, and bring a valid ID.

steps.title: Ride to your hotel
steps.body: Grab an e-trike from Cagban straight to your hotel. Most of us stay in Newcoast, near the wedding, from Jan 13 to 15. Then we move to the main beach (Stations 1 to 3) for Jan 15 to 17.
